meta.title: Bungee Fly — Bungee fitness in Doha
meta.description: Low-impact, full-body bungee fitness classes for adults and kids across Doha. See the live timetable, packages and studios.

manifesto.figure: Fig. 01 — The cord does the work.
manifesto.statementLead: We built Bungee Fly around half a second: the moment at the top of the lift when you stop working against gravity and feel

pillars.title: Teach it properly
pillars.body: Every class is coached, every harness is fitted by hand, and nobody flies before they are ready.

pillars.title: Make it reachable
pillars.body: Low impact on knees and back, scaled for every level from age three upwards.

pillars.title: Keep it beautiful
pillars.body: Calm studios, honest prices, and a timetable you can read in two seconds.

programmes.label: Programmes
programmes.title: Three ways to leave the floor.

adults.name: Group classes
adults.body: Flow for your first flights, Sculpt for slow strength, Burn when you want intervals. Up to twelve flyers, one coach.

kids.name: Kids & Mini
kids.body: Play-led classes with proper technique, taught by coaches trained to work with children.

private.name: Private sessions
private.body: One coach, one flyer, your goals. A good first step if you'd like space.

packages.title: Pay per class, or commit and save.
packages.intro: Prices shown for {studio}. Every pack is spent on classes, not months.
packages.checkout: Secure checkout by SkipCash: cards, Apple Pay and Qatar debit cards.

firstFlight.label: First flight
firstFlight.title: Never been on a cord? Good.

steps.title: Pick a Flow class
steps.body: Choose your studio and any Bungee Flow slot. It's built for first-timers.

steps.title: Arrive ten minutes early
steps.body: Your coach fits the harness by hand and walks you through the cord.

steps.title: Wear fitted sportswear
steps.body: Leggings or shorts and a fitted top. Grip socks recommended; water is on us.

steps.title: Fly
steps.body: Forty-five minutes. You'll feel it in your core tomorrow, not your knees.

install.title: Defy gravity.

install.appBody: Book in two taps, get class reminders, and keep your credits one thumb away. No app store needed.
